method: Direct view_image inspection of all three actual images plus exact benchmark-prompts.json. Independent editorial still-image judgment; no motion, audio, gameplay, canon-promotion or shipped-studio-equivalence claims.
overallDecision: REPAIR_TWO_THEN_REVIEW; environmental benchmark passes. Adult cinematic direction is demonstrated, but boss identity and scale fidelity must be corrected before batch expansion.

images.name: Vorrak, the Cinder Maw
observations: Creature has convincing mass, planted claws, compressed ground contact and a substantial ribcage. Furnace shaft, suspended elevator and retreating scouts carry excellent scale and situational evidence.

The primary head read is an enlarged crocodile with conical teeth. The specified divided mineral grinding jaw is absent as a clear identity feature. This is the central correction, not a need for more ornament.
Three near-side legs are reasonably inferable, but far-side anatomy and rear body are occluded or cropped. The intended six-limb identity is not unambiguously demonstrated.
Cold environment and restrained jaw heat work. Wet highlights are physically plausible in this flooded shaft; they do not read as toy plastic.
The animal appears to bite the slab rather than distinctly shove it with the lower grinding assembly. Current action does not yet visualize the described combat verb.
repairPriority: Preserve the image's weight, camera height, furnace setting and cold lighting. Replace the lower tooth-bearing jaw with two enormous independent mineral grinding plates separated by a clearly visible central longitudinal cleft. Each plate should have blunt interlocking ridges and asymmetric abrasion, with no conventional lower tooth row.

Shorten and broaden the skull slightly into a tunneling wedge. Put the lower plates against the slab so debris and scrape paths demonstrate forward force; keep red heat inside the assembly rather than on the whole skin.

Rotate the body toward a clearer side-three-quarter angle and open the stance. Separate the three near-side leg silhouettes; show at least the planted feet and a leg segment of each far-side counterpart. Fit the rear body inside frame. Do not pretend hidden legs were checked.

If all six legs cannot coexist with the strongest key-art composition, retain truthful occlusion but add a separate orthographic identity reference before animation or gameplay production. The final key art must still expose the unique jaw.

images.name: Avarra, the Glass Sovereign
observations: Adult face, controlled expression, physical skin and austere palette are a substantial improvement over the previous Host. The face has individual asymmetry rather than a generic cute expression.

Avarra reads considerably larger than the specified 3.2 metres. Stair separation, perspective and a much smaller challenger make exact height unrecoverable. I would not attach an exact inferred height such as eight metres, but this is clearly not a reliable 3.2-metre scale depiction.

There are three blade forms, but the right blade is cropped at its top. The other two are similar enough in pose that the pre-attack rotation is not clear. A beautiful reflective surface is not automatically an actionable tell.
The full-length pose is composed like a monumental sovereign portrait rather than a duel about to change. Hands hang at rest; neither body nor blade establishes a strong imminent action.

The fabric reads heavier and more brocaded than the requested severe silk. The white chest area reads as wrapping fabric rather than a distinct mineral mantle. Material differentiation is good globally but not faithful to these specified identities.
repairPriority: Place both adults on the same broad landing and at nearly the same camera distance. Define the challenger as 1.8 metres; Avarra is approximately 1.78 times that height. Use shared paving and a nearby 2.2-metre doorway as independent scale checks. Avoid distant tiny challengers and low-angle monument framing.
Use a chest-height medium-wide camera rather than near-ground heroic perspective. Keep her 3.2-metre stature imposing through stance and attention, without enlarging her into a giant.

Fit all three complete blades within the frame. Keep two upright; rotate the third diagonally toward the challenger so its edge and narrow sunlight band distinctly announce a strike. Preserve negative space around that blade.
Give her one small preparatory weight shift and a precise hand action connected to the turning blade. Maintain composure. The challenger should respond to that particular threat.
Reduce embroidered patterning. Show unpatterned smoke-grey silk folds and a visibly rigid white mineral chest plate with restrained diagonal fixings. Preserve the face rather than re-beautifying it.

images.name: The Pelagic Cathedral
observations: Luminous wonder is achieved without mascot proportions, candy color or toy surfaces. Pale filter structures, dark civilization remnants and the abyss have distinct material and value families.
Foreground salvage platform, broken middle bridge and distant balconies create a readable exploration promise. Guide ropes and small divers reinforce scale and stakes.
The closed shell valve is legible in the upper right and adds a withheld inhabitant without placing another character portrait in the environment.

The view has convincing suspended life and water illumination, though the perfectly planted divers and crisp platform can briefly read as an air pocket. This is a secondary clarity issue, not a reason to discard the successful composition.

The divers appear to have modern yellow scuba cylinders. That is a lore-technology compatibility question rather than a visual-quality failure; the prompt requested divers but did not define Arcanean breathing equipment.
repairPriority: Keep this as the environment quality benchmark. Do not regenerate merely to add detail.

Before canon-facing publication, confirm whether modern-style scuba cylinders belong in the selected world scope. If not, edit only the divers to original Arcanean salvage breathing equipment supported by lore, retaining credible hoses, buoyancy and harnesses.
Optional local edit: subtle exhaled bubbles and a suspended guide-rope segment can resolve underwater ambiguity. Do not add decorative particle fog or blanket bioluminescence.

batchImplications: The adult cinematic register is now established. Avoid adding darkness, blood or armor to every design as a substitute for narrative authority.
Single key art is not an anatomy sheet. Record which identity features are visible, occluded or absent; do not score absent details from the prompt as if they are present.
Numeric scale needs visual construction. Same-plane humans and common architectural units are more reliable than merely putting a tiny figure somewhere in the frame.
A dangerous state should be physically visible: an organ loading, a blade turning, a route closing. A posed figure with dramatic light is insufficient encounter evidence.
